verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documented continuous batching, advanced scheduling and PagedAttention KV-memory management serve concurrent requests efficiently, with "peak GPU utilization" claimed. A community user confirms building concurrent request handling on vLLM's KV cache and continuous batching. However, nothing documents reserving dedicated capacity per agent or session, or guaranteeing steady throughput under concurrency. missing for 10: explicit capacity reservation or isolation per session/tenant, documented throughput-stability guarantees under concurrent load, independent benchmarks of steady throughput with multiple concurrent clients

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
